name: Exchange Rate Basis 1
definition: Provides information about the terms of the foreign exchange transaction.

BaseCurrency.name: Base Currency
BaseCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange.||Usage: In the example one GBP equals xxxUSD, the unit currency is GBP.

QuotedCurrency.name: Quoted Currency
QuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the base currency is converted, in a currency exchange.
